reasons.text: About 20% of this county's corn follows corn. Here corn and soybean are a small share of the cropland, so rotations aren't compared.
This county's corn tends to yield about 29 bu/ac below its state's trend (its soil and how it is farmed, 2009–2023).
In years with a hot July (corn flowering), corn yields here tend to be about 25 bu/ac lower.

range_driver.text: What moves this county's corn range the most is July heat: from about -38 bu/ac in 2012 to about +1 bu/ac in 2018.
